text: the bell echoes through the grove
Forest stirs from her seat under the oak
an owl calls from the branches
she lifts the lantern; it sputters in the damp
Forest follows the path north
moss swallows the sound of her steps
a crow lights on the leaning trunk ahead
she pauses, regarding it
the crow tips its head and croaks once
Forest mutters: still the same omen
the wind picks up; lantern goes out
she relights it, hands shielded
shadows stretch across the path
Forest pushes deeper into the wood
somewhere ahead, water moves over stone
she thinks of the brook by the Hollow Oak
the air goes colder, sudden
her breath fogs the lantern glass
Forest whispers: who's there?
no answer; only the stream's small voice
